logline: When a lone lighthouse keeper discovers the signal radio has stopped answering, a distant, unseen presence watches from the misty cliffs.
story: Mara, the last lighthouse keeper on Fog Ridge, hears the familiar crackle of the radio fade into silence. She checks the console, sees the line still powered, yet no voice responds. Outside, a storm gathers, white curtains of wind sloughing against the tower. Unknown to her, a shadow lingers at the far cliff, watching every move. She listens, then speaks, but the words bounce back empty. A low whimper, like wind through stone, rustles the air. The radio’s screen flickers, a single green dot appears, then disappears again. Mara’s hand shakes as she turns the knob, the light spirals outward, illuminating only the empty sea and the mist that swallows the horizon. The radio tone thumps once more, a pulse that freezes the wind. In that moment, all sound dies, leaving only the echo of a heart’s slow beat that goes unheard.
